events.summary: Four Strixhaven students are led astray by a mysterious faerie and fall through an Omenpath onto Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, disturbing the balance between its two aspects.
events.quote: Four Strixhaven students are led astray by a mysterious faerie , and fall through an Omenpath onto the plane of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

events.summary: The students make new friends and recruit another student, and the faerie is revealed to be the long-lost brother of Maralen.
events.quote: The faerie turns out to be the long-lost brother of the fae queen Maralen .
